lessons.title: Packages, imports and main.
lessons.explain: Code lives in packages and execution starts at main. Imports are explicit and unused ones are errors.
lessons.exercise: Run go mod init demo, then print your name with fmt.Printf.

lessons.title: Dynamic lists with slices.
lessons.explain: A slice is a view over an array that grows with append. range gives you the index and the value.
lessons.exercise: Append five numbers to a slice and print their sum.

lessons.title: Structs and methods.
lessons.explain: Structs hold data and methods attach to types through a receiver. There are no classes and no inheritance.
lessons.exercise: Add a Cat type with its own Meow method.

lessons.title: Run work at the same time.
lessons.explain: The go keyword runs a function concurrently. Goroutines are cheap, so you can start thousands.
lessons.exercise: Start three goroutines that print their number and wait with sync.WaitGroup.

capstone: A small REST API for notes with an in-memory store.
